payload.comparison_population: drug-responsive, well-controlled seizures and healthy controls
payload.supporting_quote: Patients with drug-resistant epilepsy express significantly higher levels of blood HMGB1 than those with drug-responsive, well-controlled seizures and healthy controls.

payload.comparison_population: fever only controls (febrile illness without convulsion)
payload.supporting_quote: Serum HMGB1 and IL-1β levels were significantly higher in febrile seizure patients than in fever only controls (p < 0.05).

payload.comparison_population: West syndrome and control groups (non-CNS infections)
payload.supporting_quote: Serum and CSF HMGB1 levels were significantly higher in the encephalopathy and meningitis groups than in the West syndrome and control groups.
